Install air R Code Formatter

Source: R/fix.R
install_air.Rd

Downloads and installs the air R code formatter binary from the official GitHub releases. Supports Linux (x86_64, aarch64), macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon), and Windows.

Usage

install_air(version = "latest", force = FALSE)

Arguments

version

Specific version to install (e.g., "v0.1.0"). If "latest" (default), the latest stable release is installed.

force

Logical. If TRUE, reinstall even if air is already present. Default FALSE.

Value

The path to the installed air binary (invisibly).

Details

On Linux and macOS, the binary is installed to ~/.local/bin/air. On Windows, it is installed to ~/bin/air.exe.

See also

sonar_fix() to use air for auto-fixing R code.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Install the latest version
install_air()

# Install a specific version
install_air(version = "v0.1.0")

# Reinstall even if already present
install_air(force = TRUE)
} # }
